# Test: grove move rejects a detached worktree without changing it
setup_workspace

exec grove add --detach --name detached-move HEAD
exists ../detached-move

! exec grove move detached-move moved
stderr 'cannot move detached worktree detached-move'
exists ../detached-move
! exists ../moved
exec git -C ../detached-move rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
stdout '^HEAD$'
